# 调调 Tutorials: Import, Offline Playback and Queues

> Start with one owned track, then check importing, metadata, offline copies, queues, sleep timers and lyric sources.

## App and version

- [调调: Personal Music Player for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/diaodiao/index.md): Organise and play your own music with 调调, including file imports, Wi-Fi transfers, offline listening, lyrics, queues and compatible personal music servers.
Version listed: 1.0.3; checked 2026-11-20; iOS 17.6+ / iPadOS 17.6+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. Prepare audio for 调调: check format, size and permission separately](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-prepare-owned-audio-format-size-drm/index.md): Prepare one recognisable, traceable small audio file before importing. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [2. Import a first file into 调调 and reopen it](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-first-files-import-and-reopen/index.md): Trace a file from provider selection through importing and actual playback. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [3. Check metadata in 调调: filename, title and artwork have different sources](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-metadata-title-artist-artwork-identity/index.md): Build a field-by-field comparison for one owned track instead of relying on names or artwork. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [4. Transfer music to 调调 over Wi-Fi using the displayed address](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-wifi-browser-transfer-local-network-check/index.md): Trace one small track from a computer browser to the device, beyond merely opening the upload page. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [5. Prepare offline listening in 调调: visible, imported and playable are different states](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-offline-imported-copy-network-control/index.md): Compare one imported track online, offline and after restoring connectivity. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [6. Check the upcoming queue in 调调 with three tracks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-queue-next-track-order-small-set/index.md): Separate the current track from the upcoming queue and verify order by actual audio. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [7. Compare sequential, repeat and shuffle playback in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-sequential-repeat-shuffle-observation/index.md): Hold three tracks fixed and change only the playback mode, comparing expectation with observation. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [8. Check the sleep timer in 调调 separately from a track ending](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-sleep-timer-duration-end-check/index.md): Choose an observable short timer and check its starting conditions, ending and playback recovery. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [9. Check background and lock-screen controls in 调调 one step at a time](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-background-lockscreen-pause-output-check/index.md): Start with foreground playback and observe backgrounding, locking and recovery separately. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [10. Read lyrics in 调调: separate source text, timing and missing words](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-lyrics-source-timing-and-missing-text/index.md): Verify the track edition, then record available text, timing information and the actual lyric display. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [11. Reconcile three source files, selection counts and library results in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-multiselect-three-file-reconciliation/index.md): Prepare a manifest for three different tracks, import them together and retain item-level results rather than only a total. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [12. Compare a renamed duplicate and a new recording in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-duplicate-copy-cross-entry-result-check/index.md): Use an unchanged copy and a genuinely new sample to separate filename changes from duplicate-content handling. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [13. Connect a personal music server in 调调: check compatibility, address and library identity](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-personal-server-address-account-library-identity/index.md): Use an already confirmed compatible personal service and retain evidence of the connection and library identity. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [14. Search a personal server in 调调: known titles, result identity and no-hit cases](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-server-search-known-track-and-no-hit/index.md): Use two queries inside a verified library and identify each result’s source and recording edition. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [15. Verify local and server paths for similarly named music in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-local-server-same-track-two-paths/index.md): Retain separate provenance for an imported copy and server item instead of treating one playable path as proof of the other. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [16. Compare two music themes in 调调 1.0.1 and restore the original](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-music-themes-two-options-and-restoration/index.md): Use the published music-theme feature while checking selection, player appearance and track identity separately. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [17. Add, observe and remove a 调调 Home Screen widget](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-home-screen-widget-add-observe-remove/index.md): Use the system widget flow with actual installed choices, record display scope and preserve music data. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [18. Check light/dark readability in 调调 with the music theme fixed](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-light-dark-fixed-theme-readability/index.md): Compare light and dark states on one track and theme, retaining page-level differences rather than ranking modes. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [19. Compare 调调 player and lyric layouts as available iPad space changes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-ipad-player-lyrics-available-space/index.md): Hold track and appearance fixed while checking placement, content and return paths in two actual space states on one iPad. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [20. Recover a 调调 batch while retaining successes and retrying unresolved files](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-interrupted-batch-failed-item-recovery/index.md): Keep the original batch separate from retry rounds, correct one known condition and recheck unresolved items. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [21. Locate three audible anchors on a ninety-second track in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-ninety-second-anchors-playhead-position/index.md): Build a ten-, thirty- and seventy-second map for your own short recording, separating elapsed time, remaining time and the position actually heard. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [22. Check spoken stereo labels and a mono comparison in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-stereo-mono-spoken-channel-music-check/index.md): Use original left/right spoken labels to separate channel content, audible direction and the current playback output. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [23. Compare fixed-duration PCM WAV files in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-pcm-wav-fixed-duration-rate-depth-payload/index.md): Audit channels, sample rate, container bits and payload for two thirty-second PCM samples, then check importing, duration and audible playback separately. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [24. Map three source passages onto one combined track in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-combined-three-parts-source-local-time-map/index.md): Combine owned twenty-, thirty- and ten-second passages externally, map local passage times to track time, then locate them in the player. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [25. Separate queue duration, remaining time and paused elapsed time in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-queue-duration-elapsed-pause-time-ledger/index.md): Use owned forty-, eighty- and fifty-second clips to compare one natural queue run and a paused run, separating track duration from wall-clock elapsed time. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [26. Log three audio-to-lyric timing differences in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-timed-lyrics-three-anchor-offset-drift-log/index.md): For one verified track with available timed lyrics, use one clock for three audible onsets and lyric changes, distinguishing direction, trends and observation error. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [27. Identify repeated lyric occurrences by context and position in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-repeated-lyric-occurrence-context-position/index.md): Build occurrence cards for two repeated lines in one track edition, keeping neighboring context and audible positions instead of identifying a passage from matching words alone. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [28. Reconcile a changed two-item server collection in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-server-test-collection-before-after-membership/index.md): Change an already compatible owned test collection from A/B to B/C, then compare server data, the visible catalog and playback rather than infer agreement from equal totals. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [29. Check an imported item after moving only its external working copy in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-imported-item-after-external-working-copy-move/index.md): Preserve a master and move only a working copy between folders, then reopen its 调调 item and record source-path and local-playback states separately. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [30. Prepare source files and a one-track device handoff check for 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-new-device-source-package-one-track-check/index.md): Preserve originals and a three-track manifest, then check source availability and one imported track on your own target device without assuming automatic library migration. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [31. 调调 track ordering: reconcile one, two and ten across metadata and the queue](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-three-track-numeric-order-filename-queue-ledger/index.md): Prepare three samples with distinct spoken identities and record filenames, external track numbers, player display and the actual queue separately. Deliver an order ledger that can be heard back as one, two, ten. A file browser’s lexical order is not album order, and no native track-number sorting control is promised in 调调. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [32. 调调 cover-source experiment: distinguish embedded art from a folder sidecar](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-embedded-cover-versus-sidecar-owned-image-check/index.md): Use three owned samples with distinct audible identities: embedded artwork, a picture beside the audio only, and neither. Deliver a source ledger and display comparison without assuming folder-art scanning or treating a placeholder or similar composition as proof of online artwork retrieval. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [33. 调调 container check: distinguish AAC, M4A and a merely renamed copy](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-aac-m4a-adts-renamed-extension-container-card/index.md): From one owned recording, prepare genuine M4A and ADTS AAC assets, then change only another working copy’s extension. Deliver separate filename, external-format and 调调-response columns. Encoding and reports belong to external tools, not a claimed in-app transcoder or format inspector. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [34. 调调 silence boundaries: hear a thirty-second source and a fifteen-second external trim](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-leading-trailing-silence-trimmed-copy-boundaries/index.md): Place an owned fifteen-second passage inside a thirty-second source with leading and trailing silence, then retain an externally trimmed copy. Deliver boundaries distinguishing intended silence, content and actual playback state. Quiet openings, tails and faults are different; no trimming or automatic silence-skip feature is promised in 调调. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [35. 调调 lossless comparison: verify WAV/FLAC decoded samples before observing playback](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-wav-flac-decoded-pcm-equality-not-device-bitperfect/index.md): Create FLAC from one integer-PCM master, compare externally decoded samples in one agreed representation and separately record 调调 import and sound. Different whole files, matching decoded samples and audible playback are three conclusions. Similar sound does not certify bit-perfect device output, and a duplicate skip is not a second successful playback. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [36. 调调 same-name transfers: upload distinct recordings in separate rounds and trace responses](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-wifi-same-filename-distinct-recording-collision-ledger/index.md): Two working recordings in separate folders share one filename but have distinguishable content, titles and durations. Transfer them in separate rounds through the actual Wi-Fi flow and reconcile browser responses with device items. Predict no overwrite, rename or rejection policy, and do not manufacture success counts by repeated clicking. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [37. 调调 pause-and-timer experiment: account for a twenty-second pause in two clock models](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-sleep-timer-paused-interval-two-clock-hypotheses/index.md): First establish an uninterrupted timer baseline, then insert a deliberate twenty-second pause under the same conditions and observe what happens after resuming. Deliver two observed rounds and two paper clock hypotheses, separating content duration, manual pause and timer stopping without presuming 调调’s internal clock. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [38. 调调 instrumental-gap reading: separate lyric starts, vocal endings and the visible line](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-timed-lyric-starts-instrumental-gap-visible-line/index.md): Choose owned audio already providing usable timed lyrics and an instrumental gap between vocal passages. Build a ledger from audible boundaries and visible-line changes. A start cue does not automatically supply an end cue. A retained prior line, blank display and missing words need different evidence; no lyric editor or import format is invented. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [39. 调调 dual-widget observation: compare two instances with one playback session](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-two-widget-instances-visible-state-refresh-ledger/index.md): Where the device permits, place two widgets of the same available kind and record each instance’s actual fields and observation times against one playback session. Deliver a ledger separating a static entry, any displayed track information and real sound. No play buttons, fixed refresh deadline or two independent players are promised. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [40. 调调 long-title identification: distinguish shared-prefix recordings across three views](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-long-shared-prefix-titles-three-view-identity/index.md): Give two distinct recordings long titles sharing a prefix. Record visible text in the mini player, full player and queue, using duration and sound to verify identity. Deliver a view ledger for truncation, wrapping or full display, without treating ellipses as deleted tags or assuming in-app full-title copying or editing. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [41. 调调 queue clearing: audit the current track, upcoming entries and library separately](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-clear-up-next-current-library-three-state-check/index.md): Build a recoverable upcoming arrangement from three owned recordings and operate only an identifiable queue-clear control. Deliver separate before/after evidence for the list, current sound and library; an empty queue does not establish file deletion or guarantee uninterrupted current playback. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [42. 调调 Previous control: compare one press near the start and later in a track](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-previous-control-early-late-track-position-observation/index.md): Press the same visible Previous control once at an early and a later position in one recording. Use four independent baselines to record track identity and position, without presuming the icon always selects the preceding track or substituting double presses for single actions. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [43. 调调 Wi-Fi upload addresses: preserve host, port and path before checking the real page](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-wifi-displayed-url-host-port-path-exact-target/index.md): Copy the upload address actually displayed by 调调 into separate host, port and path columns, then verify the complete target in an owned same-network browser. Distinguish URL structure from availability without prescribing a fixed port, HTTPS or upload path. The illustrative LAN address is parsed on paper, not requested. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [44. 调调 music-package preparation: extract an owned ZIP and select two audio files from four materials](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-owned-zip-package-extract-audio-only-four-member-ledger/index.md): Distinguish archive, folder, audio and supporting notes in a small owned package. Extract through the system Files app before supplying two actual audio files to 调调. Renaming ZIP as audio does not convert it, and artwork/notes are not additional songs. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [45. 调调 MP3 durations: separate constant bitrate from a weighted variable-rate average](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-mp3-constant-variable-bitrate-weighted-duration-byte-ledger/index.md): Export MP3 copies of one owned forty-eight-second recording externally, retaining real parameters/duration before checking identity and sound in 调调. A stipulated two-interval ledger shows that equal average bitrate does not imply identical encoding, and file bytes cannot determine duration without assumptions. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [46. 调调 two-track seams: separate the complete reference, split WAV and MP3 delay conditions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-two-track-seam-lossless-reference-mp3-delay-padding-observation/index.md): Split one owned twelve-second recording at six seconds and compare the seam with the complete reference. Keep source silence, encoding delay and playback switching as separate evidence. No 调调 gapless switch or universal gapless compatibility is assumed. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [47. 调调 gain-tag checks: distinguish ReplayGain metadata from a sample-altered copy](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-replaygain-metadata-versus-baked-sample-gain-copy/index.md): Prepare an owned FLAC original, a metadata-only working copy and another with externally reduced sample amplitudes. Inspect processing evidence before observing identifiable playback in 调调. A tag does not guarantee player application, and similar sound does not establish identical file bytes. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [48. 调调 accented titles: separate two Café representations from recording identity](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-accented-title-nfc-nfd-codepoints-audio-identity/index.md): Prepare visually similar accented titles for two distinct owned recordings, retaining external NFC/NFD evidence before checking displayed titles and sound in 调调. Canonical equivalence is neither identical original code points nor identical audio. No preserved normalization form or in-app code-point inspector is promised. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [49. 调调 wired controls: compare EarPods double-press Next with the app button](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-owned-earpods-double-press-next-versus-player-control/index.md): With already-owned compatible EarPods and an identifiable playback session, compare a quick double press of the centre button with 调调’s Next control.
